sourceRefs.locator: Sections on the emergence and territorial development of the Wielbark culture, figs. 3 and 8; pp. 228–230 on Pliny, Tacitus and Ptolemy and the lower Vistula.

summary.de: Gemeinsame Grab- und Sachformen erlauben den Vergleich mehrerer Fundlandschaften. Schriftquellen verorten im weiteren Raum verschiedene benannte Gruppen.
summary.en: Shared burial practices and material forms connect several find regions. Written sources place several named groups in the wider area.
